```python
import requests
import pandas as pd

base = 'https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/NY.GDS.TOTL.ZS'
params = {
    'format': 'json',
    'per_page': 20000
}

records = []
for yr in range(2001, 2011):
    params.update({'date': f'{yr}'})
    r = requests.get(base, params=params)
    r.raise_for_status()
    data = r.json()
    # data[1] contains list of observations
    for item in data[1]:
        val = item.get('value')
        c = item.get('country')
        if c:
            rec = {
                'country': c.get('value'),
                'iso3': item.get('countryiso3code'),
                'region_id': c.get('region', {}).get('id'),
                'region_name': c.get('region', {}).get('value'),
                'year': int(item.get('date')),
                'value': float(val) if val is not None else None
            }
            records.append(rec)

raw = pd.DataFrame(records)
raw.to_csv('gross_savings_raw_2001_2010.csv', index=False)
print('Rows:', len(raw))
print(raw.head())
```

import pandas as pd

raw = pd.read_csv('gross_savings_raw_2001_2010.csv')
# Exclude aggregates: region_id in ['NA', None] or region_name == 'Aggregates'

years = list(range(2001, 2011))
qualified = pivot.dropna(subset=years)
qualified = qualified[(qualified[years] > 35).all(axis=1)]

candidates = sorted(list(qualified.index))
print(candidates)
